title: Bound worker app-server requests by stop and the round deadline
body:
Outcome: worker app-server requests stop waiting when the worker is stopped, and turn/start uses the remaining round time instead of the full timeout, so stop and the round deadline bound every request in a round. Interrupt a turn whose ack timed out once its id is known.
Source: PR #183 review attempt 3 prepass findings (src/worker/driver.ts:245 and :287, .krn/runs/review-series/326cc6e9.../records/3.json); both behaviours exist at base 6885d84 and were accepted by lead override.
